Five days
of *admin*.
slides.sub: An organiser's week in Cape Town, in 5 messages.

slides.title: “Thursday 18:30, *who's in?*”
slides.body: Post the game. Watch 38 people read it.

slides.title: “Still need *3*. Anyone?”
slides.body: Copy the names into a numbered list. Again.

slides.title: 17:04: “Sorry bru, *can't make it*.”
slides.body: Two drop out. Kick-off is in 86 minutes.

slides.title: “Guys, *R60 each* for the court.”
slides.body: Three people pay. You chase the rest all weekend.
